method: Inspected registry metadata, source implementations, bundled design-engineering skill, hooks, examples, docs, theming, utilities and dependency manifests. Inventory is separate from deep reading. Selected sections are identified where files were not read completely. Evaluations are static judgments rather than browser or performance benchmark claims.
scope_exclusions: components/ai-elements was inventoried only as directory presence, not audited or imported
Generated registry copies are metadata/build outputs, not distinct components
Unreviewed catalog items are not implicitly accepted or rejected
No full source-repository runtime build was run

inspected_files.scope: Compared duplicate implementation sections to expandable; not a second imported component
Root open/close/scroll effect, trigger/content/background, full relevant implementation
Root logic, render seams, shared status, form submit/keyboard and paired outside interaction; full relevant implementation
Timer, mobile detection, card/presentation layers, controls and layered step render; source output sections inspected
Types, root/selection logic, option and results, keyboard options container, exports; full relevant implementation
Active implementation root/trigger/content/form/parts; commented backup excluded
State/nav selection and scroll, content measurement, native touch scroll, masks and cleanup; selected implementation sections
First385 lines: root state, measurement/duration, primitive composition, trigger/overlay/content/close/header
First160 lines: progress implementation and step/context API only
First100 lines: variants/types/Slot seam; not full JSX behavior audit
First235 lines: conversions/parser, state, prop sync, picker plane/hue/text controls
Source distribution concept, metadata structure and example sections
Complete programmatic registry inventory; no claim of deep component coverage
First100 lines: index generation, JSON build and source/dependency metadata
Complete; primarily references/install rather than implementation detail
First95 lines: usage/parts and representative card composition
First85 lines plus displayed usage example
Product/weather/design-sync composed card examples and final overview; selected displayed sections
Complete; numeric ID assumption and same API across themed demo content

reconciliation.rule: One persistent measured compound disclosure; eliminate duplicate wrapper APIs and source duplicate file
Preserve ordered motion, use complete tab semantics and scoped IDs; keyboard state changes are immediate under canonical Fluidity policy
Let accessible primitives own modal/popover behavior; animation does not substitute focus/collision/scroll lifecycle
Keep neutral card composition; essential actions visible and card is not intrinsically clickable; discard hover-only shifting demo
Stack selection distinct from reorder; bounded index, contextual layering, handle-only optional drag, stable selection and inert inactive content
Prefer smaller single-motion-value distance mapping; no duplicate global streams or infinite bounce
Readable surface and optional bounded backdrop effect; no fractal distortion or mandatory layered viewport blur
Preserve host HSL-channel or full-color token format; do not mix wrappers

verification.local_type_and_browser_checks: Root integration validation owns final verification; this file records extraction evidence, not a test success claim
verification.integration_regressions: Browser regression tests reproduce and then pass stale keyboard exits and dynamic duplicate IDs/focus restoration; see development/VALIDATION.md
